raw_context:
Wellness Forever
operates an omnichannel, 24x7 lifestyle retail pharmacy and wellness chain in India. Its business model
blends traditional prescription medicines with high-margin fast-moving consumer goods (FMCG), lifestyle items, and self-browsing supermarket formats
. It relies on a hub-and-spoke supply chain, round-the-clock physical accessibility, and digital hyperlocal delivery.
LinkedIn India
Wellness Forever Medicare Limited
Core Revenue Streams
Pharmaceuticals:
Generates roughly 60% of total revenue through curative and preventive prescription medicines.
FMCG & Wellness:
Accounts for the remaining 40% via high-margin non-pharma products like personal care, cosmetics, baby care, nutraceuticals, and health foods.
LinkedIn India
Wellness Forever Medicare Limited
Operational & Distribution Strategy
Hub-and-Spoke Model:
Centralized operations anchored by a massive Zero Error Distribution Center (ZEDC) that feeds regional retail outlets efficiently.
Franchise Mart
24x7 Availability:
Physical brick-and-mortar storefronts operate continuously around the clock to capture emergency and late-night demand.
LinkedIn India
Wellness Forever Medicare Limited
Omnichannel & Hyperlocal:
Orders placed via apps or websites are fulfilled directly from the nearest physical retail store for rapid delivery.
LinkedIn India
Wellness Forever Medicare Limited
Growth & Expansion
Retail Footprint:
Operates over 430 stores across states like Maharashtra, Goa, Karnataka, and Madhya Pradesh.
Franchise Network:
Scales quickly by offering localized store partnerships backed by corporate inventory, tech infrastructure, and staff training.
